title.en: Typed long-term memory for AI agents over MCP
title.zh: 透過 MCP 提供給 AI agent 的分類型長期記憶

description.en: An MCP server with 18 tools that keeps decisions, resolved issues, open questions, and knowledge in one SQLite file per workspace, ranks recall by salience, and can query an Oracle database for vector search and audit logs.
description.zh: 一個有 18 個工具的 MCP 伺服器：把決策、已解決的問題、待解問題與知識，依工作區各存成一個 SQLite 檔，依重要度排序回想，也能查詢 Oracle 資料庫做向量搜尋與稽核紀錄。

eyebrow.zh: MCP 伺服器 · agent 記憶

headline.en: Remember the decision, not just the text.
headline.zh: 記住的是決策，不只是文字。

lede.en: A Python MCP server that files what an agent learns as decisions, resolved issues, open questions, or knowledge, in one SQLite file per workspace. Records that get used rank higher; a decay job lowers the ones nobody touches.
lede.zh: 一個 Python 寫的 MCP 伺服器，把 agent 學到的東西分成決策、已解決的問題、待解問題與知識，每個工作區存成一個 SQLite 檔。常被用到的紀錄排得比較前面，沒人碰的由衰減排程慢慢調低。

top.zh: 工具呼叫 · 工作區 my-project

lines.text: › memory_store("Decided to use SQLite | zero setup")
Decision recorded [my-project]: Decided to use SQLite (id: e63c4402)
Local search 'fastmcp' (1 results, sorted by salience):

label.zh: 已註冊的 MCP 工具
每個 CJK 字元的估計 token 數
唯一的版本，2026 年 3 月

title.en: Structured recall, not a note dump.
title.zh: 有結構的回想，不是一堆筆記。

intro.en: Writes always go to the current workspace's SQLite file. Oracle and OpenAI are optional and only come into play when reading.
intro.zh: 寫入一律進目前工作區的 SQLite 檔。Oracle 與 OpenAI 都是選配，只在讀取時派上用場。

body.en: Decisions keep what, why, and how. Resolved issues keep what and how. Open questions carry a priority from 1 to 3. Everything else is a knowledge item with a title, content, and tags.
body.zh: 決策記下做什麼、為什麼、怎麼做；已解決的問題記下問題與解法；待解問題有 1 到 3 的優先度；其餘都是有標題、內容與標籤的知識項目。

body.en: memory_store picks the type from English keywords such as decided, fixed, or a question mark, and splits a decision's what | why | how on the pipes.
body.zh: memory_store 依英文關鍵字判斷類型，例如 decided、fixed 或半形的 ?，再用 | 把決策拆成做什麼、為什麼、怎麼做。

body.en: A read or a local search hit multiplies salience by 1.05, memory_reinforce by 1.2, capped at 2.0. The decay job multiplies anything untouched for 30 days by 0.95 and never deletes a row.
body.zh: 每次讀取或本地搜尋命中，重要度乘以 1.05；memory_reinforce 乘以 1.2，上限 2.0。衰減排程把 30 天沒被碰過的紀錄乘以 0.95，但從不刪除資料。

body.en: With Oracle and an OpenAI key, memory_search runs cosine vector search. With Oracle alone, a text match ranked by salience. With neither, a text match across every mapped workspace.
body.zh: 有 Oracle 加 OpenAI 金鑰時，memory_search 做 cosine 向量搜尋；只有 Oracle 時，改用依重要度排序的文字比對；兩者都沒有，就比對所有已對應的工作區。

title.zh: CJK 感知的 session 檢查

body.en: memory_compact weighs session.md at 1.5 tokens per CJK, kana, or Hangul character, 2.0 per emoji, 0.25 otherwise, and flags it past 3,000 tokens or 100 lines. The agent does the trimming.
body.zh: memory_compact 估算 session.md 時，CJK、日文假名與韓文每字算 1.5 token，emoji 算 2.0，其他算 0.25，超過 3,000 token 或 100 行就提醒壓縮，實際整理交給 agent。

body.en: Four read-only tools search an Oracle AUDIT_LOG by keyword, date, sender, or H/M/L importance, count it, and read DAILY_REPORTS and ACTIVITY_LOG. Something else has to fill those tables.
body.zh: 四個唯讀工具可以依關鍵字、日期、寄件者或 H/M/L 重要性搜尋 Oracle 的 AUDIT_LOG、做統計，也能讀 DAILY_REPORTS 與 ACTIVITY_LOG。這些表要由別的程式寫入。

intro.en: Local tools resolve a workspace, then read or write that workspace's SQLite file. Oracle, when configured, is only ever queried, never written to.
intro.zh: 本地工具會先判斷工作區，再讀寫該工作區的 SQLite 檔。有設定 Oracle 時只會查詢它，從不寫入。

label.zh: 工具呼叫 → 工作區 → 儲存

lines.zh: 任何走 HTTP 的用戶端
工作區取自 MEMORY_WORKSPACE 或 cwd

lines.en: SQLite per workspace: read and write
lines.zh: 每個工作區的 SQLite：可讀寫

title.zh: 需要你先準備好的東西。

items.en: A workspace-map.json that maps workspace ids to folders
items.zh: 一份 workspace-map.json，把工作區 ID 對應到資料夾

items.en: A memory.db per workspace; the repo ships no schema or migrations
items.zh: 每個工作區一個 memory.db；repo 裡沒有 schema，也沒有 migration

items.en: Oracle tables filled by your own jobs, if you want vector search or audit queries
items.zh: 要用向量搜尋或稽核查詢，Oracle 的表得由你自己的排程寫入

items.en: A scheduler for --decay, if you want stale records to sink
items.zh: 想讓舊紀錄往下沉，就要自己排程執行 --decay

items.en: Secrets in environment variables rather than the plain-JSON config
items.zh: 機密資訊最好放環境變數，不要放在明文的 JSON 設定檔

title.en: Why it is shaped this way.
Typed tables over one memory blob
title.zh: 分表存放，而不是一整包記憶

body.en: Decisions, fixes, questions, and knowledge have different fields and lifetimes. Separate tables let an agent list open questions by priority or pull a decision together with its reasoning.
body.zh: 決策、修正、問題與知識，欄位不同，保存的時間也不同。分表存放，agent 才能依優先度列出待解問題，或把決策連同理由一起找出來。

body.en: Salience only changes ranking. Decay lowers a score and never removes a row, so an old record can still be listed or fetched by id; it just ranks lower in search.
body.zh: 重要度只影響排序。衰減只降分數、不刪資料，舊紀錄仍然可以列出來或用 ID 取回，只是在搜尋結果裡排得比較後面。

title.en: A character-class estimate, not a tokenizer
title.zh: 依字元類別估算，不用 tokenizer

body.en: The session check needs a threshold, not an exact count. Weighting characters by class adds no dependency and keeps CJK-heavy files from looking up to six times smaller than a flat 0.25-per-character rule would make them.
body.zh: session 檢查需要的是門檻，不是精確的數字。依字元類別加權不必多裝套件，也避免以中文為主的檔案，被一律每字 0.25 的估算方式低估到只剩六分之一。

intro.en: You need Python 3.11+ and bash or zsh. The server does not create its own databases, so you map a workspace and create memory.db once. These commands were run as written on 2026-09-30.
intro.zh: 需要 Python 3.11 以上，以及 bash 或 zsh。伺服器不會自己建資料庫，所以要先對應一個工作區，並建立一次 memory.db。這些指令已在 2026-09-30 照原樣實際跑過。

body.en: setup_config.py is optional; it writes paths, an Oracle wallet connection, and an OpenAI key to ~/.mcp-memory/config.json.
body.zh: setup_config.py 可以不跑；它會把路徑、Oracle wallet 連線與 OpenAI 金鑰寫進 ~/.mcp-memory/config.json。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/teddashh/mcp-memory-server.git
cd mcp-memory-server
pip install -e .

body.en: The workspace map turns an id into a folder under ~/Documents/Workspace.
body.zh: 工作區對應檔把一個 ID 對應到 ~/Documents/Workspace 底下的資料夾。

body.en: Save the SQL from the README as schema.sql, then run this in the same folder.
body.zh: 把 README 裡的 SQL 存成 schema.sql，再到同一個資料夾執行。

steps.code:
python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
ws = Path.home() / "Documents/Workspace/my-project"
db = sqlite3.connect(ws / ".claude-memory" / "memory.db")
db.executescript(Path("schema.sql").read_text())
PY

body.en: Run it inside your project, with the Python you installed into. Then ask the agent to call memory_status: it should show my-project, zero counts, and Oracle not connected.
body.zh: 在你的專案裡執行，並使用安裝套件時的那個 Python。接著請 agent 呼叫 memory_status：應該會顯示 my-project、全部為零的數量，以及 Oracle not connected。

steps.code:
claude mcp add memory -e MEMORY_WORKSPACE=my-project \
  -- python -X utf8 -m mcp_memory

intro.en: v0.1.0 was written and published on 2026-03-31, and its functionality has not changed since. It is not actively maintained. It still loads on current FastMCP, and the local tools work once the database exists.
intro.zh: v0.1.0 在 2026-03-31 寫完並發布，之後功能沒有再變更，目前沒有持續維護。它在目前的 FastMCP 上仍能載入，資料庫建好之後，本地工具都能正常使用。

works.en: All 18 tools register on fastmcp 4.0.10, the latest release at the time
works.zh: 18 個工具都能在 fastmcp 4.0.10（當時的最新版）上註冊

works.en: The four setup steps on this page, run as written in an empty home directory; claude mcp list shows the server connected
works.zh: 本頁的四個設定步驟，在全新的家目錄照原樣跑過；claude mcp list 顯示伺服器已連線

works.en: With a prepared memory.db: store, list, get, delete, reinforce, local search, and the session check
works.zh: memory.db 準備好之後：儲存、列出、取回、刪除、強化、本地搜尋與 session 檢查都正常

works.en: Salience tracking on reads, and the --decay job
works.zh: 讀取時的重要度追蹤，以及 --decay 衰減排程

works.en: stdio by default; --http serves streamable HTTP at 127.0.0.1:8787/mcp
works.zh: 預設走 stdio；--http 會在 127.0.0.1:8787/mcp 提供 streamable HTTP

works.en: Interactive setup_config.py for paths, an Oracle wallet, and OpenAI embeddings
works.zh: 互動式的 setup_config.py，可以設定路徑、Oracle wallet 與 OpenAI embedding

limits.en: No schema or migrations: you create memory.db, the workspace map, and any Oracle tables
limits.zh: 沒有 schema 也沒有 migration：memory.db、工作區對應檔與 Oracle 的表都要自己建

limits.en: Oracle is the only cloud database in the code, and nothing here syncs SQLite to it, writes embeddings, or fills the audit tables
limits.zh: 程式裡唯一的雲端資料庫是 Oracle，而且沒有任何程式會把 SQLite 同步過去、寫入 embedding，或填入稽核相關的表

limits.en: Search covers knowledge items only, and the vector path ignores salience
limits.zh: 搜尋只涵蓋知識項目，而且向量搜尋不看重要度

limits.en: Auto-classification reads English keywords only; a full-width ？ is not treated as a question
limits.zh: 自動分類只認英文關鍵字；全形的「？」不會被當成問題

limits.en: Decay has no floor and applies once per run, so its pace depends on your scheduler
limits.zh: 衰減沒有下限，每執行一次就套用一次，速度取決於你的排程

limits.en: Secrets are saved as plain JSON, and there are no tests or releases
limits.zh: 機密資訊以明文 JSON 儲存；沒有測試，也沒有 release

intro.en: memory_store reads English keywords, then writes one row in that workspace's SQLite file.
intro.zh: memory_store 先看英文關鍵字，再把一列寫進該工作區的 SQLite 檔。

note.en: An MCP client calls memory_store with one string.
note.zh: MCP 用戶端用一個字串呼叫 memory_store。

note.en: Words such as decided or fixed pick the table, and a halfwidth question mark marks a question.
note.zh: decided、fixed 這類英文單字決定資料表，半形問號則當成問題。

note.en: The row keeps what, why, and how, split on pipe characters.
note.zh: 這一列用直線符號拆成做什麼、為什麼、怎麼做。

note.en: The row keeps the problem and the fix, split on one pipe.
note.zh: 這一列用一個直線符號拆成問題與解法。

note.en: Priority stays 1, 2, or 3, and the default is 2.
note.zh: 優先度是 1、2 或 3，預設為 2。

note.en: The title is the first 100 characters, and the full string is the body.
note.zh: 標題取前 100 個字元，整段字串當內容。

caption.en: memory_store classifies one string with English keywords such as decided, fixed, or a halfwidth question mark, splits a decision on pipe characters, and inserts one row into decisions, resolved, open_questions, or knowledge_items.
caption.zh: memory_store 用 decided、fixed 或半形問號這類英文關鍵字分類，決策再用直線符號拆欄，然後在 decisions、resolved、open_questions 或 knowledge_items 插入一列。

intro.en: memory_search tries the richest path it can, and every path reads knowledge items only.
intro.zh: memory_search 能用多完整就用多完整，而且每一條都只讀知識項目。

note.en: The caller passes a query, and optionally a domain of all, work, or personal.
note.zh: 呼叫端傳入查詢，也可以指定 all、work 或 personal。

note.en: Vector needs Oracle plus an OpenAI key, Oracle text ranks by salience, and SQLite is the path with neither.
note.zh: 向量需要 Oracle 與 OpenAI 金鑰，Oracle 文字依重要度排序，兩者都沒有就走 SQLite。

caption.en: memory_search looks at knowledge items only. With Oracle and an OpenAI key it ranks by cosine distance and ignores salience. With Oracle alone it matches text and ranks by salience. With neither, the highlighted path, it matches text in every mapped workspace's SQLite file and raises salience on each hit.
caption.zh: memory_search 只看知識項目。有 Oracle 與 OpenAI 金鑰時依 cosine 距離排序，不看重要度。只有 Oracle 時做文字比對並依重要度排序。兩者都沒有時走圖上標出的 SQLite：比對每個已對應工作區，並在命中時提高重要度。

intro.en: memory_compact estimates a length and stops there. The agent does the trimming.
intro.zh: memory_compact 只估算長度就停住。整理內容是 agent 的工作。

note.en: More than 100 lines is enough on its own to flag the file.
note.zh: 超過 100 行，單這一項就會標記該檔。

note.en: CJK, kana, and Hangul count as 1.5, emoji as 2.0, and every other character as 0.25.
note.zh: CJK、假名與韓文每字 1.5，emoji 每字 2.0，其他字元 0.25。

note.en: Past 3000 tokens or 100 lines the status is COMPACT RECOMMENDED, and no row is rewritten.
note.zh: 超過 3000 token 或 100 行，狀態就是 COMPACT RECOMMENDED，不會改寫任何一列。

caption.en: memory_compact reads session.md beside memory.db, counts lines, and estimates tokens by character class: 1.5 for CJK, kana, and Hangul, 2.0 for emoji, and 0.25 otherwise. Either more than 100 lines or more than 3000 tokens flags the file. The tool does not trim it.
caption.zh: memory_compact 讀取 memory.db 旁邊的 session.md，數行數，並依字元類別估算 token：CJK、假名與韓文 1.5，emoji 2.0，其他 0.25。超過 100 行或超過 3000 token 就標記。這個工具本身不會刪減內容。

intro.en: Writes stay in the workspace SQLite file. Oracle and OpenAI are optional, and this server only reads them.
intro.zh: 寫入只留在工作區的 SQLite 檔。Oracle 與 OpenAI 是選配，這個伺服器只讀它們。

note.en: The client uses stdio, or streamable HTTP on loopback port 8787.
note.zh: 用戶端走 stdio，或走本機迴圈連接埠 8787 的 streamable HTTP。

note.en: Store, list, get, delete, and reinforce all open this file, which the server never creates.
note.zh: 儲存、列出、取回、刪除與強化都開這個檔，伺服器不會自己建立它。

note.en: Search, audit, daily reports, and the summary run SELECT only.
note.zh: 搜尋、稽核、每日報告與摘要都只執行 SELECT。

note.en: An OpenAI key embeds the search string only, and stored rows are not embedded here.
note.zh: OpenAI 金鑰只嵌入搜尋字串，已經存下的列不會在這裡嵌入。

caption.en: Tool calls resolve a workspace from MEMORY_WORKSPACE or the current directory, then read and write that workspace's memory.db. Across the read only line, Oracle is queried with SELECT and never inserted into, and OpenAI embeds the search text only. Audit rows, daily reports, and the activity log have to be filled by something else.
caption.zh: 工具呼叫依 MEMORY_WORKSPACE 或目前目錄決定工作區，再讀寫該工作區的 memory.db。只讀界線的另一側，Oracle 只做 SELECT、不會插入，OpenAI 也只嵌入搜尋文字。稽核列、每日報告與活動紀錄要由別的程式寫入。

intro.en: Salience only changes rank. A decay run lowers a score and never deletes a row.
intro.zh: 重要度只影響排序。衰減執行會降低分數，但不會刪掉任何一列。

note.en: memory_get and a local search hit call the same touch.
note.zh: memory_get 與本地搜尋命中，走的是同一個觸碰。

note.en: A touch multiplies by 1.05 and memory_reinforce by 1.2, both capped at 2.0.
note.zh: 一次觸碰乘以 1.05，memory_reinforce 乘以 1.2，上限都是 2.0。

note.en: python -m mcp_memory --decay multiplies rows untouched for 30 days by 0.95, once per run, with no floor.
note.zh: python -m mcp_memory --decay 把 30 天沒被碰的列乘以 0.95，每跑一次就套用一次，沒有下限。

caption.en: A read or a local search hit multiplies salience by 1.05, and memory_reinforce multiplies it by 1.2, never above 2.0. The decay command multiplies rows with no access for 30 days by 0.95 once per run and has no floor. The row stays in the table and simply ranks lower.
caption.zh: 讀取或本地搜尋命中會把重要度乘以 1.05，memory_reinforce 乘以 1.2，最高 2.0。衰減指令把 30 天沒被碰的列乘以 0.95，每執行一次套用一次，沒有下限。那一列仍留在表裡，只是排序更後面。

heading.en: From clone to a live tool

intro.en: The server does not create its database. These four steps are the quick start.
intro.zh: 伺服器不會自己建資料庫。這四步就是快速開始。

note.en: Install in editable mode on Python 3.11 or newer.
note.zh: 在 Python 3.11 以上執行 pip install -e .。

note.en: workspace-map.json points an id at a folder under the workspace root.
note.zh: workspace-map.json 把一個 ID 指到工作區根目錄下的資料夾。

note.en: You apply the README SQL so memory.db exists before the first call.
note.zh: 先套用 README 的 SQL，memory.db 要在第一次呼叫前就存在。

note.en: claude mcp add starts python -m mcp_memory with MEMORY_WORKSPACE set.
note.zh: claude mcp add 會帶著 MEMORY_WORKSPACE 啟動 python -m mcp_memory。

caption.en: Install the package, write workspace-map.json, create memory.db with the README SQL, then register python -m mcp_memory for the workspace. memory_status should then show that workspace, zero counts, and Oracle not connected.
caption.zh: 安裝套件、寫好 workspace-map.json、用 README 的 SQL 建立 memory.db，再為該工作區註冊 python -m mcp_memory。接著 memory_status 應顯示該工作區、數量為零，以及 Oracle 未連線。
